prompt: Create an original production-ready flat pixel-art UV MATERIAL ATLAS for seven independently modeled Minecraft tactical guns inspired only by broad real weapon categories: heavy revolver, compact low-bore SMG, folding-stock assault rifle, pump shotgun, bullpup bolt-action rifle, six-barrel rotary gun, and a shoulder rocket launcher. Do not draw weapons. This is a square opaque full-bleed 4 by 4 grid of 16 exactly equally sized material surface tiles, precisely aligned, no gutters or padding. No lettering, labels, logos, icons, silhouettes, perspective, lighting gradients, frame borders, or copied assets. Low contrast subtle hard pixel-art material finishes that remain legible after nearest-neighbor downsample to 256x256 (64x64 pixels per material tile), sparse subtle wear, only restrained texture detail. All tiles must be evenly lit front-on. Tactical realistic palette: charcoal gunmetal, cool steel, flat dark earth tan, olive drab, black polymer, muted brown wood. NO glowing crystals, NO cyan luminous surfaces, NO sci-fi decorations. EXACT row-major contents: Row1 tile1 dark charcoal gunmetal steel with minute restrained roughness; tile2 brushed cool medium gray steel with subtle fine block strokes; tile3 matte flat dark earth tan painted polymer with very subtle surface wear; tile4 satin bare silver steel. Row2 tile5 near-black matte polymer; tile6 desaturated olive drab armor paint; tile7 muted deep red safety paint with NO markings; tile8 light warm sand tactical paint. Row3 tile9 dark ribbed black rubber grip with clear sparse straight grooves; tile10 medium brown burnished copper bolt metal; tile11 deep desaturated green optical lens glass with tiny restrained highlight; tile12 dull brass ammunition metal. Row4 tile13 charcoal heat grille material with sparse tiny square dark slots; tile14 near-black stock-pad rubber; tile15 very dark almost black muzzle bore metal; tile16 warm medium brown walnut wood with restrained straight blocky grain for an RPG launcher heat shield. Keep all 16 squares distinct, perfectly grid aligned. This must be a usable original texture atlas, not a gun illustration or a texture atlas layout mockup. Entire background fully opaque.
normalization: Mechanical nearest-neighbor export preserving original generated pixel colors and alpha, no creative redraw
layout: 4x4 row-major; 64x64 pixels per material tile; full opaque RGBA
